verdicts.reason: A keeps the brand, but the sun icon is reduced to a plain dot and the SOLSTICE wordmark is too small to read. The headline and its 'Shop the Summer Line' call to action are bunched on the right, leaving an empty gap in the middle, and the call-to-action text is tiny. B drops the logo entirely, which breaks the brand. Its call to action is squeezed onto two lines against the right edge, splitting the phrase awkwardly, and the left side is left as an empty strip.
